sections.heading: A Day Worth Having: Explore Hoboken, NJ

blocks.html: Hoboken is one of New Jersey's most walkable, most vibrant small cities. Before you make the short drive to our dispensary near Hoboken, or after you're done with us, the city has plenty worth staying for. Here are a few of our favorite spots.

blocks.title: Hudson River Waterfront Walkway
blocks.html: The Hoboken stretch of the waterfront walkway is one of the best free experiences in Hudson County. You get unobstructed Manhattan skyline views, fresh air, and a flat path that connects several parks along the water. Walk it at golden hour and you'll understand why people move here from the city. It's photo-worthy in every season and a perfect way to clear your head before heading our way.

blocks.title: Gravity Vault Hoboken
blocks.html: Gravity Vault is Hoboken's indoor rock climbing gym, and it's genuinely fun for all skill levels. Go for a morning session before your visit, or bring friends for an afternoon of something active and hands-on. The routes challenge you without intimidating you. The energy inside is welcoming and community-focused, which makes it a natural complement to the kind of experience we aim to deliver at Lady L.

blocks.title: Maxwell Place Park
blocks.html: Maxwell Place Park is right on the Hudson waterfront and offers some of the best open green space in the city. There's a playground, open lawn, and stunning water views just steps from the residential neighborhood. People who just want to sit and breathe find something here. Check the Hoboken parks schedule for seasonal events and programming throughout the year.

blocks.title: Hudson Table
blocks.html: Hudson Table is a culinary event space that brings people together around food. It hosts hands-on cooking classes, private experiences, and team events in a warm, modern setting. If you're planning a day in Hoboken, check their calendar for upcoming classes before you arrive. It's a social, creative stop that draws curious, community-minded locals. The vibe here rhymes with ours.

blocks.title: Yoga Renew Hoboken
blocks.html: Yoga Renew offers classes and teacher training in a space that doesn't take itself too seriously. It's accessible, welcoming, and built for people at all experience levels. A morning class here followed by a drive to Lady L makes for a legitimately good day. Both spaces share a commitment to meeting people where they are and helping them feel better when they leave.

blocks.title: Carlos' Bakery
blocks.html: Carlos' Bakery is a Hoboken landmark. Known from the TV show Cake Boss, this spot has been serving the community for decades with cakes, pastries, and specialty items that are just as good as the reputation suggests. Pick something up before your drive to Lady L, or swing by on the way back. Either way, it's a classic Hoboken experience you don't want to skip.

blocks.title: Napoli's Hoboken Pizza
blocks.html: Hoboken has a serious pizza reputation, and Napoli's holds a strong place in that legacy. This neighborhood spot is casual, reliable, and exactly what you want after a full afternoon of errands. The slices speak for themselves. Stop in before the drive, or loop back after your visit with us for a well-earned meal.

blocks.title: Willie McBride's
blocks.html: Willie McBride's is one of Hoboken's most beloved bars. It's a classic Irish pub with a warm, lived-in atmosphere, strong pours, and a crowd that feels like regulars even on a first visit. End your Hoboken day here. It's the kind of place that turns a good afternoon into a great evening, and it's exactly the social note this city deserves.

items.q: Do I need a medical card to shop at Lady L?

items.q: How much cannabis can I legally buy near Hoboken, NJ?
items.a_html:
Dispensaries are allowed to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams (1 ounce) of usable cannabis per transaction. This can be made up of any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, such as purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to cannabis purchases in New Jersey?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey are subject to a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). All taxes are applied at checkout. Our team can walk you through the breakdown if you have questions.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept at Lady L?
items.a_html: We accept cash. Credit cards are not accepted for in-store purchases. All delivery orders require full payment before the order is placed. An on-site ATM is available if needed.

items.q: Where can I legally consume cannabis near Hoboken?
items.a_html: Cannabis consumption is permitted in private residences in New Jersey. Public spaces, vehicles, parks, and federal property are all off-limits. You're responsible for consuming only in legal locations. Lady L doesn't offer on-site consumption space at our dispensary near Hoboken.
